data_objects.name: country_vaccination_history
data_objects.meaning: Country-date vaccination records containing cumulative and daily vaccination measures, population-normalized measures, vaccine product labels, and source attribution.

variables.name: country
variables.meaning: Country name for the vaccination record.

variables.name: date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the vaccination record.

variables.name: total_vaccinations
variables.meaning: Cumulative number of vaccine doses administered by the date.

variables.name: people_vaccinated
variables.meaning: Cumulative number of people who have received at least one vaccination by the date.

variables.name: people_fully_vaccinated
variables.meaning: Cumulative number of people recorded as fully vaccinated by the date.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations_raw
variables.meaning: Raw daily number of vaccine doses administered.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations
variables.meaning: Daily vaccination measure distinct from the raw field; the adjustment or smoothing method is not stated.

variables.name: total_vaccinations_per_hundred
variables.meaning: Cumulative vaccine doses administered per hundred people.

variables.name: people_vaccinated_per_hundred
variables.meaning: People receiving at least one vaccination per hundred people.

variables.name: people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred
variables.meaning: People recorded as fully vaccinated per hundred people.

variables.name: daily_vaccinations_per_million
variables.meaning: Daily vaccine doses administered per million people.
variables.unit: doses per day per million people

variables.name: vaccines
variables.meaning: Vaccine product or product combination used in the country record.

variables.name: source_name
variables.meaning: Name of the organization or publication source for the record.

variables.name: source_website
variables.meaning: Website URL identifying the record's source.

structure.description: Each row represents vaccination measures for one country on one calendar date, with country and date providing the natural record context.
The table stores cumulative, daily, and population-normalized forms of vaccination measures alongside the vaccine and source fields.

uncertainties: The method distinguishing daily_vaccinations from daily_vaccinations_raw is not stated.
Blank cells do not distinguish unavailable reporting from measures that are not applicable.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels, date values, and source fields visible in train.csv.
